brief:
Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qassem said Palestinians in Gaza are "completely exhausted" by condemnation statements from Arab, Islamic, and international leaders, Shehab Wire reported. Qassem called for concrete and urgent action to halt what he described as Israeli aggression.

The comments reflect Palestinian frustration with the gap between rhetorical responses and substantive intervention by regional and global powers regarding the conflict in Gaza.
dek: Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qassem said Palestinians in Gaza are "completely exhausted" by condemnation statements from Arab, Islamic, and international leaders, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Hamas spokesman demands real action from Arab leaders over Gaza
